title: Witches in Moonlit Courtyard
description: Three witches in white robes and pointed hats stand on stone steps and a cobblestone path in a vibrant yellow courtyard at night. A fourth witch silhouette sits atop a wall holding a staff, surrounded by abundant potted yellow and orange flowers hanging from walls and placed on stairs.
prompt: Three witches wearing long white robes and pointed hats stand among vibrant potted marigolds and flowers in a Mediterranean-style courtyard at night. One witch on stone steps holds a staff, another gestures with hands, the third reaches toward hanging flower pots. A fourth witch silhouette sits on a yellow wall above. Strong yellow and orange walls contrast with deep black night sky, dramatic lighting, stylized illustration with bold outlines
